# Deuvix AI Factory

> Deuvix AI Factory is a Pakistan-based team that designs, builds and deploys AI workers (Digital FTEs), chatbots, voice agents and custom AI agents for businesses, with human oversight on important decisions.

We use spec-driven development and agentic AI systems (Python, TypeScript, OpenAI and Anthropic Agent SDKs) to automate real business workflows. Our approach is the 10-80-10 pattern: humans set direction, AI executes the middle of the work, humans review the outcome.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://deuvix-ai.com/products): All services offered, including Digital FTEs, AI Chatbots, Voice Agents, Custom Agents, Loop Engineering and FDE Consulting

## Pricing

- AI Chatbots: From $500 (USD)
- All other services: Custom quote

## Work

- [Projects](https://deuvix-ai.com/projects): Portfolio and demo projects with live sites and case studies
- [Restoran](https://deuvix-ai.com/projects/restoran): Restaurant website with digital menu and table reservations
- [B-Treasure](https://deuvix-ai.com/projects/b-treasure): E-commerce platform
- [AI Textbook](https://deuvix-ai.com/projects/ai-textbook): Interactive robotics curriculum with an AI agent
- [Tomewick AI EBook](https://deuvix-ai.com/projects/tomewick-ai-ebook): AI-powered eBook publishing platform
- [Northwind CRM](https://deuvix-ai.com/projects/northwind-crm): Customer relationship management system
